name: FROMTED Frontend Immutable Law
status: CANONICAL — sheriff / validator / DAG work law for AI and humans
purpose: Machine-readable law. Any AI (Claude, Grok, GPT) programming FROMTED frontend MUST obey this schema. Attached documents, screenshots, HTML mocks, or external specs are adapted TO this architecture; they never replace it. All frontend code lives in the GitHub frontend repository.

repository.rule: Product UI uses FROMTED themes. Internal Router/ops panels may use Operator lock. Never mix brand accents across the two without an explicit surface boundary.

modules.label: ORQUESTADOR MAXBRY PANEL DE VENTANA DE DOCUMENTOS

palettes: lime #d9ff43 as end-user product brand accent
fourth product theme inventing new primary colors
pure #000000 as default body text on blanco
forest green / gold / Christmas NCT palette on product UI
blue as primary filled brand button on matte
process: stop or escalate before LOOPs batch completion
land production UI that is static mock only with no interaction
rewrite design tokens without explicit unlock phrase from product owner
repo: store canonical frontend outside GitHub frontend repo
treat attached PDF/HTML as higher authority than this law + skills pack

work_method_dag.description: Ordered phases. AI and humans execute as a closed loop until the batch is ready for GitHub frontend review.

phases.title: Auditoría forense X-Ray
actions: List all attached documents, prior HTML, MD, JSON, and code paths relevant to the task
Classify each artifact: product UI vs Operator internal vs obsolete
Extract reusable structure and behavior; discard illegal palettes
Record gaps and conflicts against skills 01-04 and this law
Output a short X-Ray report before coding

phases.title: Planificar lote de tareas y sistema LOOPs
actions: Break work into an ordered task list (lote)
Define LOOPs: for each task, input block → implement → self-check against checklist → next task
Declare no-stop / no-escalate policy until lote complete or blocked by missing product decision
Define acceptance tests per task (visual token, interaction, i18n key)
Name the target paths in the GitHub frontend repo

phases.title: Iniciar sistema LOOPs
actions: Execute tasks in order inside the LOOP
If fail: fix in-place, do not skip
When lote complete: prepare review package for GitHub frontend repo
exit_criteria: All tasks in lote marked done or explicitly blocked with reason
Artifacts ready for repo PR / commit review

loop_semantics.input_block: Single task description + constraints + theme + module
loop_semantics.continue_until: lote empty or hard product blocker

verification_checklist: Theme is one of matte | little | blanco for product UI
Tokens match skill 01 for that theme
At least one real interaction from skill 03
i18n keys used; locales es (required), en/fr/pt when requested
No Operator lime on end-user product chrome
No static-only mock labeled as final UI
Code paths appropriate for GitHub frontend repo

attachment_policy.rule: Any attached document is evidence, not law.
attachment_policy.if_operator_internal_surface: Use DESIGN-SYSTEM-LOCK-RECOVERY tokens instead of product themes

agent_binding.claude: Obey work_method_dag phases in order. Do not invent themes. Import product tokens from skill 01.
agent_binding.grok: X-Ray first. Plan lote. Run LOOPs to completion. Frontend lands in GitHub frontend repo.
agent_binding.gpt: Treat this JSON as validator. Failed checklist items block completion claims.

unlock.theme_change_requires: Explicit user phrase unlock theme <name> or we are changing the palette
unlock.law_change_requires: Explicit product-owner revision of this file version
